lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ኣባ ኣቡነ ሰላማ ትጉህ ሓዋርያ/2/
ሰባኺ ወንጌል ብርሃን ኢትዮጵያ
[[/chorus]]

ኣባ ኣቡነ ሰላማ ክቡር ቅዱስ ግብሩ
[[highlight]]ኣባ ኣቡነ[[/highlight]] ኣነስ ኣምሂሩኒ
[[highlight]]ኣባ ኣቡነ[[/highlight]] ስበኽ ስበኽ ኢሉ
[[highlight]]ኣባ ኣቡነ[[/highlight]] ፍቕሩ ቀስቂሱኒ

ኣባ ኣቡነ ሰላማ

ኣምላከ ሰላማ ዘልዓለም ይወደስ
ብነፍሲ ብስጋይ ፈጺመ ክፍወስ

ኣባ ኣቡነ ሰላማ ዝኽርኻ ዝዘከረ
[[highlight]]ኣባ ኣቡነ[[/highlight]] ስምካ ዝጸውዐ
[[highlight]]ኣባ ኣቡነ[[/highlight]] ገድልኻ እንትንበብ
[[highlight]]ኣባ ኣቡነ[[/highlight]] ብልቢ ዝሰምዐ

ኣባ ኣቡነ ሰላማ

ኣብ ምድራዊ ሕይወት ይስዕር ፈተና
ምስኡ ስለዘሎ ኣምላከሰላማ

ኣባ ኣቡነ ሰላማ ይርዕዱ ኣጋንንቲ
[[highlight]]ኣባ ኣቡነ[[/highlight]] እንክጽዋዕ ስምካ
[[highlight]]ኣባ ኣቡነ[[/highlight]] ተኣምር ይፍጸም
[[highlight]]ኣባ ኣቡነ[[/highlight]] ብሕያው ገድልኻ

ኣባ ኣቡነ ሰላማ

ሰላማ ምስጢሩ ንዝገለጸልካ
እግዚኣብሔር ይመስገን እንቋዕ ደስ በለካ

ኣባ ኣቡነ ሰላማ ገዳምካ ዝመጸ
[[highlight]]ኣባ ኣቡነ[[/highlight]] ብፍጽምት እምነት
[[highlight]]ኣባ ኣቡነ[[/highlight]] ብኽብሪ ይነብር
[[highlight]]ኣባ ኣቡነ[[/highlight]] ዘልዓለም ሕይወት

ኣባ ኣቡነ ሰላማ

ሓዘን ዝኸበቦ ተስፋ ዝቖረጸ
ብምምጻእ ‘ቲ ብርሃን ሕይወቱ መኣዘ
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
ʾAba ʾabune selama tiguh hawarya/2/
Sebakhi wengel birhan ʾityop'ya
[[/chorus]]

ʾAba ʾabune selama kibur qidus gibru
[[highlight]]ʾAba ʾabune[[/highlight]] ʾanes ʾamhiruni
[[highlight]]ʾAba ʾabune[[/highlight]] sibekh sibekh ʾilu
[[highlight]]ʾAba ʾabune[[/highlight]] fiqhru qesqisuni

ʾAba ʾabune selama

ʾAmlake selama zelʿalem yiwedes
Binefsi bisgay fetsime kifwes

ʾAba ʾabune selama zikhrikha zizekere
[[highlight]]ʾAba ʾabune[[/highlight]] simka zitsewʿa
[[highlight]]ʾAba ʾabune[[/highlight]] gedlikha ʾintinbeb
[[highlight]]ʾAba ʾabune[[/highlight]] bilbi zisemʿa

ʾAba ʾabune selama

ʾAb midrawi hiywet yisʿir fetena
Misʾu silezelo ʾamlakeselama

ʾAba ʾabune selama yirʿidu ʾaganniti
[[highlight]]ʾAba ʾabune[[/highlight]] ʾinkitswaʿi simka
[[highlight]]ʾAba ʾabune[[/highlight]] teʾamr yiftsem
[[highlight]]ʾAba ʾabune[[/highlight]] bihyaw gedlikha

ʾAba ʾabune selama

Selama mist'iru nizgeletselka
Egziabher yimesgen ʾinqwaʿi des beleka

ʾAba ʾabune selama gedamka zimetse
[[highlight]]ʾAba ʾabune[[/highlight]] biftsimt ʾimnet
[[highlight]]ʾAba ʾabune[[/highlight]] bikhbiri yinebr
[[highlight]]ʾAba ʾabune[[/highlight]] zelʿalem hiywet

ʾAba ʾabune selama

Hazen zikhebebo tesfa ziqhoretse
Bimmitsaʾi ‘ti birhan hiywetu meʾaze
